301.desc:
<color=#ffffff>Welcome back to the Admiralty, Commander. We expect great things from you.</color>
<color=#A7A7AAFF></color>

602.name: Seabreeze Villa
602.desc:
<color=#ffffff>Set sail for the best deserted island vacation ever!</color>
Awarded to Commanders who participated in the "Uncharted Summer" event.

603.name: Marvellous Invitation
603.desc:
<color=#ffffff>A piece commemorating an unforgettable soirée night, awarded to those who gracefully delivered invitations far and wide.</color>
<color=#A7A7AAFF>"Castle of Celebrations" event reward.</color>

606.name: Ebbing Waves
606.desc:
The waves flow and the winds blow at sea, the best place to be! 
<color=#A7A7AAFF>Obtained in the "Pleasure, Leisure, and Treasure" event.</color>

607.name: Memories from the Frontier
607.desc:
A symbol of your memories of the frontier, of pioneering, and of the Wild West.
<color=#A7A7AAFF>Given to Commanders who participated in the Wild West Vacation Log event.</color>

610.name: Tropical Waves
610.desc:
Walk along the beach and lend an ear to the waves. 
<color=#A7A7AAFF>Obtained by participating in the Midsummer Returns: The Villa Reconstruction event.</color>

611.name: Holographic Auction
611.desc:
Lock your greatest auction success in a dazzling holographic display!
<color=#A7A7AA>Obtained from the "Top Bidder" event.</color>

612.name: Level S Datastream
612.desc:
The data is pouring in – seize the moment of victory!
<color=#A7A7AA>Obtained from the "Top Bidder" event.</color>
